messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Rank function in NIMBLE
parts:
Hi Alex,

We haven't written a rank function. There are a few options, including writing your own nimbleFunction or using nimbleRcall or nimbleExternalCall to call out to an existing rank function.

There was some discussion of this on the list a while back: https://groups.google.com/g/nimble-users/c/SWSKDf1Ke7Q/m/JC2RCSiOBgAJ
Hopefully that can get you started.

-chris
